ridley_scott_s_long_awaited_epic_disappo.headline: Gladiator II

ridley_scott_s_long_awaited_epic_disappo.why_it_matters: The film’s streaming return gives fans another chance to experience the continuation of a classic franchise despite its theatrical underperformance.

yona_dawn_sequel_production_upgrade.headline: Night Tales Club
yona_dawn_sequel_production_upgrade.summary: Disney+ released a trailer for the upcoming Japanese supernatural horror series Night Tales Club, confirming a January 2027 premiere window.

crunchyroll_s_darkest_anime_also_has_the.headline: The Vermilion Mask
crunchyroll_s_darkest_anime_also_has_the.summary: Fall 2026 seinen anime The Vermilion Mask continues its dark narrative as protagonist Peru loses his right hand in episode 2.

crunchyroll_s_darkest_anime_also_has_the.why_it_matters: The show’s stark tragedy sets it apart as the darkest anime currently streaming on Crunchyroll, appealing to fans of intense seinen storytelling.

poison_ivy_live_action_hbo_2026.headline: Poison Ivy Live-Action Series in Development for HBO Max
poison_ivy_live_action_hbo_2026.summary: A live-action Poison Ivy series is in development for HBO Max, produced by The Penguin showrunner Lauren LeFranc, but it will not be part of Matt Reeves’ Batman universe.

spider_man_s_coolest_disney_series_confi.headline: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
spider_man_s_coolest_disney_series_confi.summary: Series creator Jeff Trammell says the team is already working on Seasons 3 and a potential Season 4 of the Disney+ animated series.
highlights: Season 2 is set to premiere on Disney+ on January 13, 2027
The show was renewed for Season 3 shortly after Season 1 aired, allowing early development work
Creator Jeff Trammell confirmed the team is actively developing both Seasons 3 and 4, though Season 4 is not officially greenlit
spider_man_s_coolest_disney_series_confi.why_it_matters: Continued development promises a quicker rollout of new episodes, keeping fans engaged with the alternate‑universe Spider‑Man story.

dc_year_of_wonder_louise_simonson_2026_1.headline: Wonder Woman
dc_year_of_wonder_louise_simonson_2026_1.summary: DC announced 2027 as the Year of Wonder, kicking off with Louise Simonson writing Wonder Woman #41.

Artist Cian Tormey will illustrate a four‑issue story that teams Diana with Lois Lane

dc_year_of_wonder_louise_simonson_2026_1.why_it_matters: The new creative team promises a fresh direction for Diana after a controversial Tom King run.

years_ago_this_legendary_shonen_anime_fi.headline: One Piece
years_ago_this_legendary_shonen_anime_fi.summary: The One Piece anime marks 27 years on air, shifting to a seasonal format in 2026 and unveiling two new anime projects plus a Netflix reboot slated for February 2027.
highlights: The series adopted a seasonal schedule in 2026, releasing 26 episodes per year covering the Elbaph arc
Two new anime projects were announced, including a first-ever canon story adaptation from the manga
Netflix’s reboot of One Piece is set to premiere in February 2027, adapting roughly 60 chapters in its first seven episodes
years_ago_this_legendary_shonen_anime_fi.why_it_matters: These developments confirm One Piece’s continued dominance and long‑term growth in the shonen anime market.

magic_knight_rayearth_english_dub_2026.headline: Magic Knight Rayearth
magic_knight_rayearth_english_dub_2026.summary: The English dub of the Magic Knight Rayearth reboot premiered on Crunchyroll on October 21, 2026.
highlights: The reboot’s English dub debuted on Crunchyroll as part of the Fall 2026 slate

magic_knight_rayearth_english_dub_2026.why_it_matters: It brings a classic CLAMP isekai to new audiences with a fresh English voice cast after three decades.

the_simpsons_showrunner_teases_apu_s_fut.headline: The Simpsons Reintroduces Apu with New Voice Actor Sunil Maholtra
the_simpsons_showrunner_teases_apu_s_fut.summary: The Simpsons has brought back Apu in Season 38, recasting him with Sunil Maholtra and promising more appearances.
highlights: Apu returns with his first speaking role since 2017 in the episode “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening,”
Sunil Maholtra is the new voice of Apu, while Janina Gavankar replaces Janine for Manjula
Showrunner Matt Selman confirmed the Nahasapeemapetilon family and Kwik‑E‑Mart will feature more prominently going forward
the_simpsons_showrunner_teases_apu_s_fut.why_it_matters: The recast addresses past controversy and signals a renewed focus on representation for South Asian characters.

anime_trailer_haru_to_gen_2026_10_21.headline: Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~
anime_trailer_haru_to_gen_2026_10_21.summary: A short-format TV anime adaptation of Yuka Ōshima's manga will debut on January 4.
highlights: Teaser reveals cast: Bin Shimada as Gen, Hiromi Igarashi as Haru, Mayuko Kazama as Sakura
Anime will air on TV Kanagawa (tvk) at 9:55 p.m. JST (7:55 a.m. EST)
Directed by Kōdai Satō with animation by IMAGICA Infos, Imageworks Studio and Studio Nanahoshi
anime_trailer_haru_to_gen_2026_10_21.why_it_matters: The series brings a unique, age‑focused family drama to broadcast TV, expanding the short‑anime format.

midnight_spider_man_makes_uncle_ben_s_de.headline: Midnight Spider-Man (Marvel’s Midnight Universe)
midnight_spider_man_makes_uncle_ben_s_de.summary: Marvel’s new Midnight Universe imprint launches Midnight Spider-Man, a body‑horror reimagining where Uncle Ben is killed by a spider bite before Peter Parker’s transformation.
highlights: Midnight Spider-Man is part of Marvel’s Midnight Universe, alongside Midnight X‑Men and Midnight Fantastic Four
The story flips Peter Parker’s origin: Uncle Ben is bitten by the spider first, leading to a gruesome death

midnight_spider_man_makes_uncle_ben_s_de.why_it_matters: It reshapes a foundational Spider‑Man moment, offering fans a fresh, horror‑driven perspective on the hero’s origin.

the_rings_power_finally_reveals_the_stor.headline: The Rings of Power Season 3 Trailer
the_rings_power_finally_reveals_the_stor.summary: Amazon released the first trailer for Season 3 of The Rings of Power, revealing Sauron forging the One Ring.

The season promises major battles featuring Elves, Dwarves and Men against Sauron’s forces
the_rings_power_finally_reveals_the_stor.why_it_matters: The forging of the One Ring is a pivotal moment in Tolkien’s legendarium, and its on‑screen debut promises a major narrative climax for fans of the series.

tom_taylor_mikel_janin_dc_departure_2027.headline: Tom Taylor and Mikel Janín to Leave Detective Comics in 2027
tom_taylor_mikel_janin_dc_departure_2027.summary: Tom Taylor and artist Mikel Janín will conclude their run on Detective Comics with the six‑issue Clark Kent: Murderer arc, ending their tenure in 2027.

tom_taylor_mikel_janin_dc_departure_2027.why_it_matters: Their departure closes a notable era that featured high‑profile storylines like the anti‑fear virus and the Clark Kent murder mystery, impacting Batman’s narrative direction.

dark_horse_full_february_solicits_baldur.headline: Dark Horse February 2027 Solicits Reveal New Baldur’s Gate III, Barbie, and Blue Eye Samurai Launches
dark_horse_full_february_solicits_baldur.summary: Dark Horse Comics announced its February 2027 solicit list, debuting Baldur’s Gate III #1, Barbie: Together in Time #1, and Blue Eye Samurai: Cry of the Yurei #1 among other titles.

dark_horse_full_february_solicits_baldur.why_it_matters: The lineup expands Dark Horse’s portfolio with high‑profile video‑game adaptations and a fresh Barbie adventure, signaling continued cross‑media growth.

boom_studios_full_january_solicits_and_s.headline: Hellraiser: Hellbound Hearts #1

First issue is 24 pages, priced at $4.99, and goes on sale January 6, 2027
boom_studios_full_january_solicits_and_s.why_it_matters: The series revives the iconic Hellraiser brand with fresh creators, promising a modern take on its classic horror themes.

image_comics_full_january_solicits_and_s.headline: Image Comics January 2027 Solicits

new_marvel_s_blade_report_indicates_the_.headline: Marvel’s Blade Video Game
new_marvel_s_blade_report_indicates_the_.summary: A reported investigation suggests the upcoming Marvel Blade game at Arkane Studios faces possible cancellation as the studio races to find a buyer by November 13.

the_apothecary_diaries_director_breaks_s.headline: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
the_apothecary_diaries_director_breaks_s.summary: Season 3 of The Apothecary Diaries is currently airing, with the director detailing major artistic and narrative shifts as the story moves westward.

avengers_doomsday_pedro_pascal.headline: Alien (new film)
avengers_doomsday_pedro_pascal.summary: A new Alien movie is in early development, focusing on the android David from the prequel series rather than being a sequel to Alien: Romulus.
highlights: The project is being written by Aaron Guzikowski, who previously worked with Ridley Scott on the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves.
The film will tie into the 2010 prequel sequels Prometheus and Alien: Covenant, using David as the connective element.
Michael Fassbender is not formally attached and no director has been announced, indicating the film is still in its early stages.

jp_gov_corp_anime_manga_expansion_2026.headline: MCM London Comic Con October 2026 Pre‑Opening Walk Highlights
jp_gov_corp_anime_manga_expansion_2026.summary: A pre‑opening walkthrough at MCM London Comic Con showcased major pop‑culture displays such as Ultimate Grogu, Bandai Gundam, Tamagotchi and Final Fantasy.

the_dungeon_crawler_carl_webtoon_series_.headline: Dungeon Crawler Carl

Published by Vault Comics

tangles_trailer_2026_10_23.headline: Tangles
tangles_trailer_2026_10_23.summary: The trailer for the animated adaptation of Sarah Leavitt’s graphic memoir Tangles has been released.

apothecary_diaries_film_trailer_2026_10_.headline: Oni Press January 2027 Solicits Reveal New Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake and Dr. Syn Comics

attack_titan_and_jujutsu_kaisen_studio_s.headline: Vinland Saga Season 3
attack_titan_and_jujutsu_kaisen_studio_s.summary: Creator Makoto Yukimura confirmed there has been no progress on a third season of the Vinland Saga anime.

keenspot_january_solicits_mark_spears_th.headline: The Crying Boy Vol. 1 (Keenspot)
keenspot_january_solicits_mark_spears_th.summary: Keenspot’s January 2027 solicitations feature a collected edition of The Crying Boy, timed with news of a major motion‑picture adaptation.

rocketeer_rights_loss_disney_2026.headline: The Rocketeer
rocketeer_rights_loss_disney_2026.summary: The Rocketeer Trust has filed a notice to reclaim the rights to The Rocketeer from Disney, with termination set for June 12, 2028.

rebellion_january_solicits_ad_50th_year_.headline: 2000 AD 50th Anniversary & Judge Dredd Megazine #500
rebellion_january_solicits_ad_50th_year_.summary: Rebellion’s January 2027 solicitations celebrate 2000 AD’s 50th anniversary with a special, new Progs, a Visual History hardcover, and the landmark Judge Dredd Megazine #500.

the_morning_after_an_open_bar_the_night_.headline: Open Bar at MCM London Comic Con

bakudo_action_game_s_reveals_switch_vers.headline: Bakudo Action Game

major_shonen_jump_anime_confirms_crunchy.headline: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3

eleceed_trailer_2027_release.headline: Absolute Batman #25
eleceed_trailer_2027_release.summary: Absolute Batman #25, the oversized finale of Scott Snyder and Nick Dragotta’s first 25‑issue cycle, was released today.
highlights: The issue pits Bruce Wayne against Jack Grimm, the Absolute Joker, for the first time in the series.

eleceed_trailer_2027_release.why_it_matters: It signals a major narrative shift for the Absolute Batman line and tests long‑time fans with a divisive new direction.

south_park_confirms_kenny_s_replacement_.headline: South Park Season 29 Episode 4 “Guinea Pig On A Stick”
south_park_confirms_kenny_s_replacement_.summary: South Park released a first‑look trailer confirming Randy as Kenny’s replacement in episode 4 of Season 29.

phantom_busters_announcement_2026.headline: Phantom Busters

naruto_s_most_exciting_battle_against_ma.headline: Naruto Shippuden Blu-ray Set 12

classic_hollywood_monsters_come_life_new.headline: Hide Nor Hair
classic_hollywood_monsters_come_life_new.summary: DC Vertigo announced a new six‑issue limited series titled Hide Nor Hair.
highlights: Written by Adam Smith with art by Bob Quinn
Explores 1950s Hollywood monster‑making and a hidden artist’s revenge
First issue releases January 6, 2027 with variant covers by Reiko Murakami, Jasmine Darnell and Niko Henrichon
classic_hollywood_monsters_come_life_new.why_it_matters: The series expands Vertigo’s legacy of strange, horror‑infused storytelling for adult comic fans.

daily_report_about_my_witch_senpai_manga.headline: About My Witch Senpai
daily_report_about_my_witch_senpai_manga.summary: The manga About My Witch Senpai has concluded its run.
highlights: The series began on Manga Cross in August 2018
Chapter 42 was released in November 2020
A sequel continuation started with chapter 43 in April 2022
Seven Seas Entertainment issued the fifth English volume in November 2025
daily_report_about_my_witch_senpai_manga.why_it_matters: Fans receive closure on the magical romantic comedy’s storyline.

james_gunn_just_when_he_ll_settle_the_dc.headline: The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast
james_gunn_just_when_he_ll_settle_the_dc.summary: James Gunn announced a one‑off podcast episode to clarify the canon status of his 2021 film The Suicide Squad within the new DCU.
highlights: The episode will air on Friday, October 30, 2026, featuring James Gunn, Jennifer Holland and Steve Agee
The podcast is positioned as the definitive guide to what counts as canon in the DCU
The discussion will address inconsistencies such as Bloodsport’s Kryptonite bullet versus the timeline established in the 2025 Superman film
james_gunn_just_when_he_ll_settle_the_dc.why_it_matters: Clarifying the film’s canon status will resolve fan confusion about the continuity between the DCEU and the emerging DCU.

dcu_suicide_squad_retcons_podcast.headline: Bronze Star #1
dcu_suicide_squad_retcons_podcast.summary: American Mythology Press announced the debut of the supernatural western series Bronze Star #1 by Mike Baron and Pat Broderick for January 2027.
highlights: Written by Eisner‑award winner Mike Baron and illustrated by veteran artist Pat Broderick
Features gunslinger Harley Brogden confronting cursed lawmen and werewolves in the mining town of Cobb’s Gap
Blends classic western tropes with Lovecraftian horror for a unique genre mash‑up
Part of American Mythology’s January 2027 solicit lineup alongside Contest of Creatures and Fright Night
dcu_suicide_squad_retcons_podcast.why_it_matters: The collaboration of two veteran creators brings a fresh, horror‑infused take to the western comic niche.

animehunch.com/witch-on-the-holy-night-u.headline: What ties the new Witch on the Holy Night trailer to the wider TYPE‑MOON universe?

death_stranding_anime_2027.headline: Death Stranding Isolations
death_stranding_anime_2027.summary: A new hand‑drawn anime series set in the Death Stranding universe will stream on Disney+ in 2027.
highlights: The series was announced at Kojima Productions’ BEYOND THE STRAND event in Tokyo and a teaser trailer was released.
It will be a fully original story featuring new characters, set in North America after the Chiral Network is reconnected.
E&H Production is handling traditional 2D animation, with Takayuki Sano directing and Tow Ubukata writing the screenplay.
Hideo Kojima serves as executive producer, and the series will stream exclusively on Disney+ or other Disney services.
death_stranding_anime_2027.why_it_matters: It expands the Death Stranding franchise into animation, reaching new audiences while offering fresh narrative content for fans.

dc_batman_casting_update_2026_10_30.headline: DCU Batman Casting Update
dc_batman_casting_update_2026_10_30.summary: James Gunn clarified that no actor has been secretly cast as Batman in the DCU and that the role will likely go to someone around the same age as Superman star David Corenswet.
highlights: Gunn confirmed Batman has not been secretly cast despite rumors
He said the future Batman will be roughly the same age as Superman, about 33
Gunn indicated the casting will focus on the best fit rather than star power
dc_batman_casting_update_2026_10_30.why_it_matters: The casting approach could bring a fresh, less‑celebrity‑driven Batman to the DCU, potentially changing the franchise’s tone.

dc_waller_series_status_2026_10_30.headline: Waller (DC Universe series)
dc_waller_series_status_2026_10_30.summary: James Gunn confirmed the Amanda Waller series remains in development but has not been greenlit and is not a current priority for DC Studios.
highlights: Gunn said the Waller show was strongly developed but never greenlit because it didn’t reach the desired stage
The series was announced as part of DC Studios’ initial shared‑universe plans with Viola Davis set to reprise Amanda Waller
The project is no longer a primary development focus as of August 2026, with no production schedule or release date announced
Gunn affirmed Waller’s character will still appear in the DCU alongside King Shark and Weasel
dc_waller_series_status_2026_10_30.why_it_matters: The status of the Waller series indicates how DC Studios is prioritizing its upcoming slate and the future of a key character in the new DCU.

patrick_stewart_s_friend_years_x_men_cos.headline: Patrick Stewart Tribute by Ian McKellen
patrick_stewart_s_friend_years_x_men_cos.summary: Ian McKellen posted a heartfelt Instagram tribute honoring the late Patrick Stewart, highlighting their decades‑long friendship and shared theatrical history.
highlights: McKellen warned Stewart against taking the role of Jean‑Luc Picard, recalling their early days at the Royal Shakespeare Company
He noted Stewart’s appointment as Chancellor of Huddersfield University as a proud achievement
McKellen officiated Stewart’s 2013 wedding to Sunny Ozell and mentioned Stewart’s final, unreleased performance will be in Avengers: Doomsday
patrick_stewart_s_friend_years_x_men_cos.why_it_matters: The tribute underscores the deep personal bond between two iconic actors whose work shaped both the X‑Men franchise and stage theatre, resonating with fans across media.

patrick_stewart_s_inspiring_viral_video_.headline: Sir Patrick Stewart Passes Away, Remembered for Advocacy and Iconic Roles
patrick_stewart_s_inspiring_viral_video_.summary: Sir Patrick Stewart died, prompting tributes that highlight his advocacy work and his final film role as Professor X in Avengers: Doomsday.
highlights: Stewart’s death was confirmed earlier today, with fans mourning his loss across multiple franchises
His final on‑screen role was as Professor X in the upcoming film Avengers: Doomsday
A 2013 Comicpalooza video of Stewart urging fans to ‘take care of yourself’ has gone viral after his passing
He spoke about his work with Refuge, supporting domestic‑violence victims, and advocated for PTSD awareness
patrick_stewart_s_inspiring_viral_video_.why_it_matters: Stewart’s influence extended beyond his iconic characters, shaping fan communities through his humanitarian advocacy.

crunchyroll_officially_all_one_piece_epi.headline: One Piece Anime Catalog Fully Available on Crunchyroll India
crunchyroll_officially_all_one_piece_epi.summary: Crunchyroll has added all 1,180 episodes of the One Piece anime to its Indian library, completing the series’ catalog in the region.
highlights: All episodes from 326 to 891 were added on Oct. 25, 2026, covering arcs such as Thriller Bark, Marineford, Fish-Man Island, Dressrosa and Whole Cake Island
The first 325 episodes were added in September 2026, and the platform has streamed the series since September 2023 starting with the Wano Country arc
With this addition, Indian viewers can now stream the entire One Piece television anime for the first time legally
Crunchyroll will continue simulcasting new episodes in 2027 as the series returns with the Elbaph arc
crunchyroll_officially_all_one_piece_epi.why_it_matters: Completing the catalog gives Indian fans full access to the long‑running series and supports the franchise’s global expansion.

dcjokers_status_2026_10_30.headline: Joker’s DCU Status Clarified
dcjokers_status_2026_10_30.summary: James Gunn confirmed that the Joker has not yet been established in the new DC Universe.
highlights: Gunn said the Joker’s existence in the DCU is still undefined
Batman has appeared in Creature Commandos, but the Joker remains absent
Harley Quinn’s origin is tied to the Joker, but the film only references an unnamed ex‑boyfriend
Gunn indicated Harley Quinn will likely return to the DCU if Margot Robbie reprises the role
dcjokers_status_2026_10_30.why_it_matters: The Joker’s presence—or lack thereof—will shape future DCU storylines and Harley Quinn’s character development.

rascal_dream_film_us_ca_2026_02_21.headline: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film Screens in U.S. and Canada
rascal_dream_film_us_ca_2026_02_21.summary: Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures will hold a three‑day theatrical screening of the final Rascal Does Not Dream film in the U.S. and Canada.
highlights: The film will be screened on February 21, 23, and 24 in the United States and Canada.
It is the latest installment of Hajime Kamoshida’s Rascal Does Not Dream series and shares its title with the 15th and final novel volume.
Returning staff include director Sōichi Masui at CloverWorks, scriptwriter Masahiro Yokotani, and composer fox capture plan.
Aniplex will distribute the film and Crunchyroll streamed an English‑subtitled trailer.
rascal_dream_film_us_ca_2026_02_21.why_it_matters: It marks the theatrical debut of the series’ concluding chapter, giving fans a final chance to experience the story on the big screen.

solo_leveling_ragnarok_season3_return.headline: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3
solo_leveling_ragnarok_season3_return.summary: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok has confirmed its return with a new artist for Season 3, though a release date remains unannounced.
highlights: The series announced Season 3 on the official D&C Webtoon X account, revealing a new illustrator after the original artist JIN entered military service.
Season 3 follows the Season 2 cliffhanger where Ammut threatens Ganga and Pia, and the story is still early, having adapted only about 70 novel chapters so far.
The webtoon will debut on Korean platforms first, with English releases expected on Tappytoon after the upcoming shutdown of Tapas in March 2027.
solo_leveling_ragnarok_season3_return.why_it_matters: Fans of the hit manhwa finally get news of the continuation despite the long hiatus caused by the artist’s conscription.

destiny_unchain_anime_announcement_2026.headline: Destiny Unchain Online TV Anime
destiny_unchain_anime_announcement_2026.summary: A TV anime adaptation of the Destiny Unchain Online novels has been announced for a 2027 debut.
highlights: Ikumi Hasegawa will voice the lead character Crim/Kou Mitsuki
Kōichi Hatsumi is directing the series at studio Voil
Seiko Takagi oversees series scripts and Masashi Kudo handles character design
The teaser promotional video and visual were revealed alongside the cast announcement
destiny_unchain_anime_announcement_2026.why_it_matters: It brings a popular web novel and manga series to a televised format, expanding its audience.

wound_bandage_cast_2026_10_30.headline: Wound & Bandage
wound_bandage_cast_2026_10_30.summary: The romantic‑comedy anime adaptation of Umihoshi Nanai's manga announced two new cast members, Yōko Hikasa and Yuka Iguchi.
highlights: Yōko Hikasa will voice Matsu Daemon and Yuka Iguchi will voice Magical Penpengusa
The series will premiere on AT‑X on January 9 and stream on ABEMA half an hour later
J.C. Staff is producing the anime under director Miyuki Ishida with scripts by Susumu Yamakawa
The manga originated on Kodansha's Comic Days app in August 2024
wound_bandage_cast_2026_10_30.why_it_matters: Adding veteran voice talent highlights the growing profile of this new romantic‑comedy series.

marvel_s_most_dangerous_anti_hero_made_h.headline: The Punisher
marvel_s_most_dangerous_anti_hero_made_h.summary: The Punisher debuted in Amazing Spider-Man #129 on October 30, 1973, marking the start of Marvel’s most controversial anti‑hero.
highlights: Created by Gerry Conway and first appeared in Amazing Spider-Man #129 (1973)
Initially introduced as a one‑shot villain who targeted Spider-Man
Backstory revealed in Marvel Preview #2 (1975) showing his family’s tragic death
The character’s gun‑wielding vigilantism sparked long‑running debates about violence in comics
marvel_s_most_dangerous_anti_hero_made_h.why_it_matters: The Punisher’s debut reshaped Marvel’s anti‑hero landscape and continues to influence discussions on morality and gun violence in popular media.

gunn_spinoff_dc_secret_2026.headline: Polka-Dot Man Potential TV Series Discussed by James Gunn
gunn_spinoff_dc_secret_2026.summary: James Gunn revealed he has discussed a possible TV show centered on Polka-Dot Man’s mother, tentatively titled The Krills, for the DCU.
highlights: Gunn wrote Polka-Dot Man into The Suicide Squad script and is considering expanding his story
He mentioned a TV series about Abner Krill’s mother could be called The Krills
The concept is still only discussed and not in active development
The series would act as a pre‑quel focusing on a canonically dead character
gunn_spinoff_dc_secret_2026.why_it_matters: Exploring obscure characters like Polka-Dot Man could broaden the DCU’s storytelling palette and introduce new heroes.

kadokawa_launches_kadokawa_world_manga_e.headline: Kadokawa World Manga English Label Launch
kadokawa_launches_kadokawa_world_manga_e.summary: Kadokawa has launched the "Kadokawa World Manga" label on its KadoComi platform to release ongoing manga series in English.
highlights: The label offers opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English to international readers
Launch lineup includes four new titles: Brain Alive, masterlynx, Kimiko Ueno’s series, and Yūho Ueji’s Immortal Peach Princesses
Kadokawa plans to add more titles over time and uses the label as a publishing platform for the Kadokawa World Manga Atelier initiative
kadokawa_launches_kadokawa_world_manga_e.why_it_matters: It expands English-accessible manga from Kadokawa, supporting global fans and emerging international creators.

fortnite_s_next_big_crossover_showcases_.headline: Fortnite’s Next Big Crossover Showcases One Piece’s Powers in the Game
fortnite_s_next_big_crossover_showcases_.summary: Fortnite is launching the Treasure Hunters mini‑season on November 1, featuring a One Piece‑themed island and character abilities.
highlights: The Treasure Hunters mini‑season introduces an 80‑player island called Crossbones Isle with locations like Arlong Park and Windmill Village.
Players can use abilities based on One Piece characters such as Luffy’s Gum‑Gum Fruit and Zoro’s Three Sword Style.
The crossover was first announced on October 24, 2026, with a full gameplay trailer released on October 30.
Additional captains like Lil Uzi Vert and Cap’n Hatsune Miku will join later in the season.
fortnite_s_next_big_crossover_showcases_.why_it_matters: It brings the popular One Piece franchise into a major live‑service game, expanding its reach to a global gaming audience.

gunn_dcu_canon_reminder.headline: James Gunn Has a Blunt Reminder for Marvel Fans Questioning DCU Canon
gunn_dcu_canon_reminder.summary: James Gunn told Marvel fans that he was constantly asked about continuity during his time at Marvel, in response to questions about DCU canon.
highlights: Gunn announced a special podcast to examine whether The Suicide Squad is canon to the DCU as part of DC Super‑Villain Month
He posted on Threads that he was asked about continuity “constantly” while working on Guardians of the Galaxy
The article references past MCU continuity debates involving Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., The Defenders, Agent Carter and the X‑Men Netflix series
gunn_dcu_canon_reminder.why_it_matters: The comment highlights that continuity scrutiny is not unique to the DCU and reflects ongoing fan interest in shared‑universe canon across both major comic franchises.

archie_comics_full_january_solicits_vale.headline: Betty and Veronica's Valentine's Spectacular (One Shot)
archie_comics_full_january_solicits_vale.summary: Archie Comics' January 2027 solicitations feature a one-shot starring Betty and Veronica with two new Valentine-themed stories.
highlights: Written by Ian Flynn with art by Dan Parent and others
Includes two stories: Little Archie battling rude Valentines and Katy Keene on a movie-set boxing storyline
Scheduled for release on January 13, 2027
Priced at $7.99 and includes multiple covers and bonus pinups
archie_comics_full_january_solicits_vale.why_it_matters: The one-shot highlights classic Archie romance while introducing fresh story angles for longtime fans.

this_gundam_anime_had_the_coolest_redesi.headline: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
this_gundam_anime_had_the_coolest_redesi.summary: The 2000 Toonami release of Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz introduced extensive mobile suit redesigns that modernized the series for U.S. audiences.
highlights: Debuted on Toonami in early 2000, boosting Gundam Wing’s U.S. popularity
Three‑episode OVA featured major visual upgrades, including wings on Wing Gundam Zero and darker paint schemes for Heavyarms and Tallgeese III
Redesigns set a new aesthetic standard for the franchise and influenced later Gundam model releases
The series concluded the original storyline 30 years after its Japanese debut, marking a nostalgic closure for fans
this_gundam_anime_had_the_coolest_redesi.why_it_matters: The redesigns demonstrated how updated animation can revitalize classic series for new markets, shaping future Gundam releases.

marvel_starwars_ai_deal.headline: Star Wars & Marvel Soundboard Packs on Voicemod
marvel_starwars_ai_deal.summary: Disney licensed Star Wars and Marvel audio clips to voice‑changing platform Voicemod, launching purchasable soundboard packs for creators.
highlights: Voicemod announced a licensing agreement with Disney to offer soundboards featuring Star Wars and Marvel quotes and effects
The first Star Wars packs for The Mandalorian and Grogu are already available, with more releases planned
Each pack contains 20 prerecorded clips and costs $9.99 (or $7.99 for premium subscribers)
Voicemod reports 5.7 million monthly active users, targeting streamers on Twitch and Discord
marvel_starwars_ai_deal.why_it_matters: The deal shows Disney’s expanding use of AI‑driven products to monetize iconic franchise assets beyond traditional media.

hiragi_san_s_house_vampires_manga_gets_t.headline: Hiragi-san's House of Vampires
hiragi_san_s_house_vampires_manga_gets_t.summary: Miki Yoshikawa's Hiragi-san's House of Vampires manga is receiving a TV anime adaptation.
highlights: The anime will be produced by Unlimited Produce in collaboration with TMS Entertainment.
Kodansha's K Manga service is publishing the manga in English.
The announcement was made via an official website and visual release.
The manga, which began in 2021, has reached its sixth volume as of November 2025.
hiragi_san_s_house_vampires_manga_gets_t.why_it_matters: Fans of Yoshikawa's previous works can now anticipate a new animated series from a popular creator.

manga_up_global_crimson_prince_the_perfe.headline: Manga UP! Global Expands English Catalog with Seven New Series
highlights: Seven titles—including Crimson Prince, The Perfect Cross-Dressing Couple, and Not Quite Love—were released on Manga UP! Global over a ten‑day span
Each series spans diverse genres from supernatural comedy to post‑apocalyptic adventure
The additions showcase works from creators such as Sōta Kuwahara, Mikaduki Lamp, and Daisuke Hagiwara
manga_up_global_crimson_prince_the_perfe.why_it_matters: The expanded lineup broadens English‑speaking readers’ access to fresh, varied manga from Square Enix’s catalog.

exclusive_preview_the_lab_press_releases.headline: The Lab Press launches Portable Editions of Super Science Vol. 1, Creatures & Corridors, and Essentials Vol. 1
exclusive_preview_the_lab_press_releases.summary: The indie publisher The Lab Press has released compact portable editions of three award‑winning graphic novels, now available in book and comic shops.
highlights: Portable Editions of Super Science Volume 1, Creatures & Corridors, and Essentials Volume 1 are now on sale
All three titles have earned IPPY, Storytrade, Foreword INDIES and Independent Book Publishers Association awards
The editions retain the full story and art of the hardcovers in a pocket‑size format
Super Science Volume 2 is slated for early 2027, building anticipation for the series
exclusive_preview_the_lab_press_releases.why_it_matters: The new format makes critically‑acclaimed indie graphic novels more accessible for readers on the go, expanding their reach beyond collectors.

interpol_antics_osaka_spd_sumerian_janua.headline: Interpol Antics & Osaka SPD in Sumerian Official January 2027 Solicits
interpol_antics_osaka_spd_sumerian_janua.summary: Sumerian’s January 2027 solicitations feature the Interpol Antics graphic novel and the new Osaka S.P.D.
highlights: Interpol Antics graphic novel expands the band’s 2004 album with a story by Nathan Yocum and Santi Guillen
Osaka S.P.D. #1 launches as a sequel to Osaka Mime, created by Andy Leavy and Hugo Araujo
Both titles are slated for release on January 6, 2027 as part of Sumerian’s upcoming lineup
interpol_antics_osaka_spd_sumerian_janua.why_it_matters: The releases bring licensed music‑inspired storytelling and a continuation of a popular horror comic universe to fans.

superherohype.com/video-games/703103-for.headline: One Piece Invades Fortnite: Timeline of the Treasure Hunters Crossover

anime_freefire_daybreak_2026.headline: Free Fire Daybreak
anime_freefire_daybreak_2026.summary: The anime adaptation of Garena's Free Fire game will premiere its first episode at Brazil's CCXP event on December 5, with a worldwide release slated for spring 2027.
highlights: World premiere of episode 1 scheduled for December 5 at CCXP26 in São Paulo
Directed by Ken Takahashi and produced by studio Candy Box
Co‑produced by Kadokawa and Garena, with worldwide broadcast and streaming planned
Series set to debut in spring 2027
anime_freefire_daybreak_2026.why_it_matters: It marks the first major anime series based on the globally popular Free Fire battle‑royale franchise, expanding the game's audience into anime fans.

zdarsky_eic_2026.headline: Marvel Creative Summit with New EIC Steve Wacker
zdarsky_eic_2026.summary: Chip Zdarsky detailed the first Marvel Creative Summit under Editor‑in‑Chief Steve Wacker, highlighting a shift toward creator‑focused strategy.
highlights: Zdarsky praised Wacker’s story notes as “bangers” that improved his upcoming Avengers arc
The summit emphasized strategy, character development, and creator needs over big crossover pitches
Wacker, Brad Winderbaum, and David Abdo are steering Marvel toward stronger stories and art
zdarsky_eic_2026.why_it_matters: The new leadership approach could shape the direction of Marvel’s flagship titles and future multimedia adaptations.

vin_diesel_teases_the_new_cars_fast_furi.headline: Fast Forever (Fast & Furious 11)
vin_diesel_teases_the_new_cars_fast_furi.summary: Vin Diesel posted new car photos confirming pre‑production has begun on the final Fast & Furious film, Fast Forever, slated for a March 17, 2028 theatrical release.
highlights: Vin Diesel shared Instagram photos of a garage full of potential film cars, captioning “Preproduction The casting of cars is always the fun part.”
The film is written by Michael Lesslie and directed by Louis Leterrier, who also directed Fast X.
Fast Forever is scheduled for theatrical release on March 17, 2028, with Diesel serving as a producer.
The update marks the first concrete visual confirmation that the franchise’s concluding chapter is moving forward after years of speculation.
vin_diesel_teases_the_new_cars_fast_furi.why_it_matters: The visual confirmation of pre‑production revives fan excitement for the long‑awaited finale of a decade‑spanning franchise.

cardfight_vanguard_veil_lift_announced.headline: Cardfight!! Vanguard Veil Lift
highlights: The Veil Lift TV anime was revealed via an announcement PV on the franchise’s official X account
More details will be released on December 7
It commemorates the series’ 15th anniversary with a 2027 release
A second season of the Ghost Meets Gal mini‑anime was also confirmed, produced by AtoriE
cardfight_vanguard_veil_lift_announced.why_it_matters: The new series expands the long‑running Cardfight!! Vanguard franchise as it reaches its 15th anniversary, promising fresh content for fans.

simon_and_kirby_s_airborne_battle_blue_b.headline: Blue Bolt #7 (Novelty Press, 1940)
simon_and_kirby_s_airborne_battle_blue_b.summary: Joe Simon and Jack Kirby's Golden Age comic Blue Bolt #7 is slated for auction on November 5, 2026.
highlights: The issue features the Green Sorceress adopting WWII blitzkrieg tactics against Blue Bolt.
It includes wartime stories by Paul Gustavson and Andrew McWhiney.
CGC lists 15 Universal entries, with two graded 5.0 and four higher.
The auction will be part of the Golden Age Century Comics Showcase Auction VI, lot #40378.
simon_and_kirby_s_airborne_battle_blue_b.why_it_matters: The sale highlights the enduring collector interest in early Simon‑Kirby collaborations and WWII-era comic storytelling.

anime_hiragi_vampire_adapt_2026.headline: Hiiragi-san Chi no Kyuuketsu Jijou TV Anime
anime_hiragi_vampire_adapt_2026.summary: An official website has confirmed a television anime adaptation of Miki Yoshikawa's manga Hiiragi-san Chi no Kyuuketsu Jijou.
highlights: The adaptation was announced via a new official website featuring a teaser visual.
Unlimited Produce by TMS is handling the planning and production of the series.
Kodansha published the sixth manga volume in November 2025 and has been simul‑publishing the manga in English on K Manga since May 2024.
anime_hiragi_vampire_adapt_2026.why_it_matters: The series brings a popular supernatural rom‑com manga to a broader TV audience, expanding its reach beyond manga readers.

jon_favreau_s_greatest_marvel_role_isn_t.headline: Jon Favreau’s early Marvel role as Foggy Nelson in Daredevil (2003) and its director’s cut (2004)
jon_favreau_s_greatest_marvel_role_isn_t.summary: Jon Favreau portrayed Franklin “Foggy” Nelson in the 2003 Daredevil film, with a substantially expanded role in the 2004 director’s cut.
highlights: Favreau played Foggy Nelson alongside Ben Affleck’s Daredevil in the 2003 film
The R‑rated director’s cut released on home video in 2004 added 30 minutes of footage, giving Foggy a courtroom subplot
The director’s cut removed the theatrical love scene and is considered a stronger version of the movie
Seth Rogen auditioned for Foggy but was deemed too young for the attorney role
jon_favreau_s_greatest_marvel_role_isn_t.why_it_matters: The expanded director’s cut showcases Favreau’s early contribution to Marvel cinema and highlights a richer portrayal of Foggy Nelson before the character’s later prominence in the Netflix series.

cosplayer_enako_sings_voice_acts_isshiki.headline: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love
cosplayer_enako_sings_voice_acts_isshiki.summary: Kadokawa released a full promotional video for the upcoming anime adaptation of Ayune Araragi's manga, revealing cosplayer Enako as both the opening theme singer and a voice cast member.
highlights: Enako will perform the opening theme "Gō Yoku Koi o Seisu!?" and voice the nurse Nene Haneshita
The series is directed by Kazuya Komai at Sakura Create with scripts overseen by Deko Akao
Advanced screening of the first two episodes is scheduled for December 13 in Tokyo
The anime will air on AT-X, Kansai TV and Tokyo MX
cosplayer_enako_sings_voice_acts_isshiki.why_it_matters: Enako’s involvement highlights a rare crossover of popular cosplay talent into mainstream anime music and voice acting.

msb_comisma_fund2026.headline: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and Comisma Anime Production Fund
msb_comisma_fund2026.summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and IP platform Comisma have agreed in principle to create a 10 billion‑yen fund to finance anime projects.
highlights: The fund aims to manage 10 billion yen (≈US$63.4 million) by the end of fiscal 2027
It will finance about 10 anime projects over three years, with investor returns tied to broadcast‑rights fees and merchandise revenue
Comisma will contribute IP sourcing, project development, and production expertise through its studio Qzil.la
The initiative seeks to broaden investment access beyond traditional production committees
msb_comisma_fund2026.why_it_matters: It introduces a new financing route that could ease capital constraints as global demand for anime outpaces production capacity.

mystique_mcu_return_2026.headline: Frank Miller’s Daredevil Run (Issues #158‑191) Marks 44‑Year Milestone
mystique_mcu_return_2026.summary: Frank Miller’s seminal run on Daredevil, culminating with issue #191’s “Roulette” in 1982, is recognized as a lasting influence on Marvel’s flagship street‑level hero.
highlights: Miller wrote and drew Daredevil from issue #158 through #191, introducing Elektra and cementing Kingpin as his greatest foe
The final issue, #191, was released on October 26, 1982, ending the acclaimed run with the story “Roulette”
Miller’s run deepened Matt Murdock’s character, exploring moral ambiguity and setting the stage for later arcs like “Born Again”
mystique_mcu_return_2026.why_it_matters: The run reshaped Daredevil’s tone and legacy, influencing every subsequent writer and cementing iconic elements still central to the character today.

lucca_comics_games_renews_award_h_ctor_g.summary: Lucca Comics & Games revived the Oesterheld Award, honoring the creator of The Eternaut, during its 60th‑anniversary ceremony.
highlights: The Oesterheld Plaque, first created in 1986, was presented on October 29, 2026 to nephew Martín Oesterheld.
The award celebrates dialogue and understanding among peoples across media and was relaunched with the heirs and charity Emergency.
A jury of comics and cultural leaders, including Igort and José Muñoz, will decide future recipients.
lucca_comics_games_renews_award_h_ctor_g.why_it_matters: Reviving the award highlights the enduring link between comics and human‑rights advocacy.

The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.
The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.
The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.
Renowned Conan the Barbarian Illustrator Returns for New Omnibus Release
Titan and Penguin Random House's listing for the Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 promises unseen bonus material, a section of "rarely seen artwork" as well as an all-new introduction from Conan comics legend, Gary Kwapisz. Known for his detailed artwork that brought some of Conan's most savage scenes to life, Kwapisz worked not only on The Savage Sword of Conan but also Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

Bride of the Barrier Master TV Anime Cast Reveal News
Bride of the Barrier Master TV Anime Reveals 5 More Cast in New Teaser Video
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
Kadokawa revealed on Monday a new teaser promotional video, third teaser visual, and additional cast members for the television anime of Kureha's Bride of the Barrier Master (Kekkaishi no Ichirinka) light novel series. Kadokawa also announced that the anime will stream on Netflix and on other streaming platforms.
Additional new cast members include:
Kanon Takao as Hazuki Ichise, Hana's twin sister
Hiroto Shimizu as Nozomi Ichinomiya, Saku's younger brother
Yuzuki Tamukai as Azuha, Hana's shikigami that rests on her hair like an ornament
Taihi Kimura as Aoi, a shikigami in human form created by Hana
M.A.O as Miyabi, another shikigami in human form created by Hana
The anime will star Akari Kitō as Hana Ichise and Kikunosuke Toya as Saku Ichinomiya.
Tōru Kitahata (Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It, Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!, Hinako Note) is directing the anime at TROYCA. Minami Murayama (ATRI: My Dear Moments six episodes, IDOLiSH7 Third Beat! three episodes animation director) is designing the characters, and Yūko Kakihara (Blue Box, Cells at Work!, 2022 & 2024 U Kadokawa unveiled five new cast members for the upcoming Bride of the Barrier Master anime and confirmed its Netflix streaming. The new R-rated movie continues the story begun in Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall, which released in August.
As seen in the trailer, Knightquest picks up after Batman and Bane's brutal fight that left Bruce Wayne with a broken back. In the aftermath, Bane declares dominion over Gotham City and releases many of Batman's greatest villains back into the public. To fight back, Bruce passes the mantle to another, Jean-Paul Valley, the religiously zealous vigilante known as Azrael, which comes as a disappointing shock to both Nightwing and Robin.
In the trailer, Azrael dishes out ruthless, brutal, violent justice to criminals, first in Batman's traditional cape and cowl before transitioning to a suit of Batman armor. Check out the trailer below.

Akira Failing in Love Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!
Harekawa launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2024, and the eighth volume on September 16. Viz Media published the manga's fourth volume on September 8.
Kadokawa published one compiled book volume of Senpai, This Can't Be Love! in July 2019. Yen Pressreleased the manga in English in June 2024.
Kadokawa published the first volume of Sempai! Danjite Koi de wa! Brush up sequel manga in September 2020, and the second volume in May 2023. Yen Press released the sequel manga's first volume in December 2024.
Harekawa launched the Three Exorcism Siblings (Tengu Barai no San Kyōdai) manga in Coamix's Web Comic Zenyon in 2021. Coamix published the manga's first volume in 2022, and the seventh and final volume in September 2023. Titan Comicslicensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on July 28.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Akarui Mirai
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Akarui Mirai Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025. Kaihō writes the story while Kurageso draws the art. Houbunsha shipped the second compiled book volume on July 10.
The manga centers on Mirai, a girl who is not very good at socializing. A foul-mouthed AI from the future tells her she is going to die alone if she doesn't change, but Mirai isn't sure exactly how she is supposed to make friends.
Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba launched the original School-Live! manga in Manga Time Kirara Forward in 2012, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga's 12th and final compiled volume shipped in January 2020. Kaihō and Chiba launchedGakkō Gurashi! ~Otayori~, a sequel to the manga, in Manga Time Kirara Forward in June 2020, and ended it in August 2021.
Kaihō is also known for writing scripts for anime, and wrote the anime adaptation of his School-Live! manga. He was also the head writer on both Danganronpa 3 anime (as well as their "Hope Arc" special), was co-writer alongside Makoto Fukami on the anime adaptation of Fukami's Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka manga, and was also co-writer on the Akudama Drive original anime alongside its director Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso’s Akarui Mirai manga will conclude with its next chapter in the October 23 issue of Manga Time Kirara Forward. publication_fingerprints.headline: Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast The official website for the anime of Nagano's Chiikawa manga announced on Friday that the anime will temporarily pause the regular airing of new episodes, and will instead run a "revival" rebroadcast of 25 older "influential" episodes until December 25. The revival rebroadcast will focus on episodes early in the anime's run, as well as episodes that are connected to the recent Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu (Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island) anime film.
The Chiikawaanimepremiered in April 2022, and it previously aired every Friday withinFuji TV's morning news and entertainment program Mezamashi Terebi, before it began airing twice a week on Tuesdays and Fridays in April 2023. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, and is streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles. ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV began streaming a selection of 20 episodes from the anime on August 20.
Child actress Haruka Aoki (Liza in the Japanese dub of Mighty Express) voices the titular character Chiikawa as her first television anime voice acting role. Child actor Makoto Tanaka (Okko's Inn) voices Hachiware. Ari Ozawa voices Usagi.

Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2 News
Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2's Video Reveals 5 Cast Members
posted on  by Rafael Antonio Pineda
The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira's Mission: Yozakura Family (Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen) manga revealed a new promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video reveals five new cast members for the anime.
The new cast members include:
Hōchū Ōtsuka as Alexandryu
Miku Itō as Shura
Yumiri Hanamori as Cyber Demon Lord Giga
Sumire Uesaka as Dr. Mozu
Naomi Shindoh as Hulang
The announcement also revealed the character Kosmos Akizakura (seen below), but did not reveal the voice actor for the character.
The second part of the second season will premiere on MBS, TBS, and 26 other channels on October 11 at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EDT).
The rock band Humbreaders performs the new anime's opening theme song "Forever Song," and dance and vocal group KID PHENOMENON performs the new ending theme song "I'm Still Breathing."
Disney describes the anime's story:
High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. publication_fingerprints.headline: The Fake Alchemist
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Fake Alchemist As an indie hit that became a legendary sensation, surpassing 1 million copies in its commercial edition in Japan, this new monumental “isekai” finally gets a TV adaptation!
In the city-state of Orichalconia, a world where alchemy and magic are deeply rooted in the lives of the people, the reincarnated Paracelsus ekes out a living as an alchemist while hiding his “cheat skills”.
However, his life changes dramatically one day after he enters into a contract with a shaman slave-girl, Nora, and later meets Coco, an elf who has lost all four limbs and five senses.
To save Coco, what began as a rescue attempt in a small workshop gradually escalates into a battle involving alchemy and sorcery, space and even the gods themselves—
The curtain now rises on this story, filled to the brim with “everything fantasy”!
Sugiura and Umemarulaunched the manga on Kadokawa's KadoComi website in June 2023. The manga is ongoing, and Kadokawa released the fifth compiled book volume on February 20. Kadokawa is releasing the manga in English digitally. Yen Pressreleases the manga in print, with the second volume scheduled for release on June 23.

Penguin Gives An English Bookshop A Grant To Fund Kids Reading Comics
Penguin Random House gives out a grant to an English bookshop to help fund schoolkids reading comics
Article Summary
- Penguin Random House UK awarded 40-plus independent shops grants from its £150,000 Children’s Bookshop Grant 2026.
- The Children’s Bookshelf in Hereford won funding for a comics, manga and graphic novels reading project for kids.
- The scheme targets Year 5 and 6 reluctant readers, including neurodivergent and dyslexic pupils, via school visits.
- Penguin Random House says the grants will spark reading for pleasure, support communities and inspire new ideas.
Penguin Random House UK has named over forty independent bookshops as recipients of the Penguin Children's Bookshop Grant 2026. Bookshops were able to apply for funding between £1,500 and £5,000, out of a £150,000 total. The grants will fund a range of projects, including a reading engagement programme centred around graphic novels and manga. That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 News
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 Anime Returns for 3rd Part in July 2027, Clayman's Revenge Spinoff Anime Debuts in April
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
The staff for the fourth That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken) anime season revealed on Friday that the anime will return for its third cours (quarter of a year) in July 2027. In addition, the staff revealed that Wataru Kajika's That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman Revenge) spinoff manga will get a television anime that will debut in April 2027.
Takehito Koyasu is returning to the franchise to voice Clayman.
Kentarō Sugimoto (episode director for Blue Lock, Laid-Back Camp TV 3) is directing the spinoff anime at 8-Bit. Yūji Haibara, who handled graphic design for previous entries in the franchise, is overseeing the series scripts. Asumi Hashimoto (sub-character design for The irregular at magic high school TV 3) and Hideki Sakai (chief animation director for previous entries in the franchise) are designing the characters.

Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Anime, My Melody & Kuromi Stop‑Motion Series Nominated for International Emmy The International Academy of Television Arts & Sciences announced on Wednesday the nominees for the 2026 International Emmy Awards. The Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 anthology anime got a nomination in the Short-Form Series category, and the My Melody & Kuromi stop-motion animation series was nominated in the Kids: Animation category.
Winners will be announced at New York City on November 23.
The Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 had its world premiere in October 2025 during the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival 2025 at the TCL Chinese 6 Theatre in Hollywood. It had a limited two-week theater screening run in nine cinemas throughout Japan starting in the same month. The eight-episode anime screened in two four-episode parts. The first part includes the titles A Couple Clucking Chickens Were Still Kickin' in the Schoolyard, Sasaki Stopped a Bullet, Love is Blind, and Shikaku. The second part includes the titles Mermaid Rhapsody, Woke-Up-as-a-Girl Syndrome, Nayuta of the Prophecy, and Sisters. There was also a two-week screening run in South Korea at MEGABOX theaters. Horror Collector The 13th season of American Horror Story, simply subtitled 13, debuted its first three episodes yesterday, Sept. 24, and it's already breaking records with audiences — just not the types of records the series was hoping for. Season 13 currently has the lowest Rotten Tomatoes audience score of all previous seasons.
American Horror Story's 13th season has a 32% audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. A critic score has not yet been compiled, but the show overall across seasons has a 77% critic score and a 64% audience score. Aside from 13, only four other seasons of the horror anthology series have garnered below a 60% Rotten Tomatoes audience score, with NYC (Season 11) at 42%, Double Feature (Season 10) at 50%, Cult (Season 7) at 52%, and Roanoke (Season 6) at 57%.
Season 13 Was Highly Anticipated
Unlike previous seasons of American Horror Story, which are mostly standalone stories, possibly with some tangential connection to a previous season, 13 connects to almost every tale told previously in the anthology series.

Future GPX Cyber Formula's New Anime Short Reveals Cast, Staff, Screening on February 19
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Saturday that its planned new anime short for the Future GPX Cyber Formula series will screen alongside a new HD remastered "movie edition" of the Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal compilation OVA in Japan starting on February 19, 2027. The new short anime is titled Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA, and is a direct sequel to the 1998 Future GPX Cyber Formula Sin anime.
Character designer Hirokazu Hisayuki and chief mechanical animation director Satoshi Shigeta drew the below poster for the new anime short.
Series director Mitsuo Fukuda is overseeing the new "movie edition" of Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal.
The main staff for the new Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA short includes:
- Planning, Production: Sunrise

Ayumu Murase, who voices Iruma Suzuki, shared the following comment:
“I think it’s going to develop into something that makes you wonder, ‘What’s going to happen!?’ I’m really looking forward to it myself, and I hope everyone will come out to see it as well. For now, I’ll do my best with the recording, so please look forward to it!”

“More than anything, I’m really looking forward to it. I’ve been told by the people around me not to say anything, so I can’t really say anything (laughs), but we’re working very hard on it, so I hope you’ll wait patiently.”
You can watch the announcement video below.

ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 600 million circulating copies worldwide in March this year. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong.
The anime also debuted new theme songs for the ongoing arc. The opening song’s title is “Luminous,” and it’s performed by AiNA THE END. The ending song is “That Future” by Jisoku 36km.

Long-Running Anime Series with 100+ Episodes Highlighted by CBR There is no shortage of outstanding anime series that don’t need more than a dozen episodes to fully captivate their audiences. However, considering how many of the medium’s all-time fan-favorite titles span hundreds of episodes, there’s no denying that ambitious, long-running anime series have their intrinsic appeal.
Long anime series are not for everyone; they are a substantial time commitment and seldom manage to keep their quality consistent without losing momentum or falling back on filler. However, among them, there exist remarkable examples of long-term storytelling that make sticking around for 100+ episodes worth it, to the point of viewers wishing these adventures could go on forever.

- Getting blacklisted by gaming vendors feels real as Heroclix and Magic orders stall, vanish, or go unanswered for weeks.
- Repeated emails, calls, and website orders lead to ghosting, missed shipments, and lost sales to big-box stores and rivals.
- A shorted August shipment remains unresolved, fueling fears that unpaid balances are being used to freeze future orders.
- After more than a decade selling gaming products, vendor silence now threatens customer trust, revenue, and long-term business.

AD Police Files (1990) 4K Restoration Bubblegum Crisis was one of the premier cyberpunk anime franchises of its day, known for its signature, almost sacrilegious use of bright colors and a pop music-esque aesthetic within the genre. Now, its contentious sequel is getting a modernized update, and the upgraded version finally has a release date.
AD Police Files was known for being very different compared to Bubblegum Crisis, but it's since become a cult classic in its own right. A modern 4K restoration of the 1990s OVA is on the way, offering viewers a better glimpse at its grit and gore. The newly released trailer is just a taste of how beautiful it still is, and the 4K edition is the version fans have waited over three decades for.
One of the Most Brutal '90s Cyberpunk OVAs Gets a 4K Upgrade

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.
The voice cast consists of:
- Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno
- Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya
- Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai
- Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno
Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.
Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

According to the report, the new Spider-Man television series is looking to adapt the second arc of Spider-Man's "Clone Saga." That arc involved two clones of Peter Parker: Ben Reilly, a.k.a. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
New York Public Library Announces Best New Comics of 2026 We spend a lot of time reminding people of the importance of bringing new readers into libraries, especially those in their younger years. Through them, we get a sense of what moves a community, what interests them or worries them or even makes them dream. It’s simple, libraries inform and reveal the cultural waylines of a people. The more readers we get, the more we know about what’s occupying our minds.
One group of readers that doesn’t always get the same level of attention but is just as crucial to the readership conversation are librarians, the people who curate and purchase the books we can check out at our local book temples. Their ability to engage with the wide range of genres, formats, and styles largely dictates what’s available on shelves. They are among some of the most voracious readers in existence.
The New York Public Library has put together a list of the best new comics of 2026 based on librarian input and feedback. It’s a special list as it offers a glimpse into the reading habits, intellectual leanings, and potential fandoms shared among NYC’s book ambassadors. As such, it is an infectious selection of comics.

Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!

publication_fingerprints.headline: Warner Bros. to Disappear After Mega-Merger with Paramount Skydance
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Warner Bros. to Disappear After Mega-Merger with Paramount Skydance Warner Bros. is officially disappearing. After the upcoming mega-merger with Paramount Skydance, not only is Warner Bros. losing its identity, but it's losing its core people.
Per a new report by Puck News, the Warner Bros. everyone knows is ending. The mega-merger is set to be completed on Oct. 6, and David Ellis just revealed the new merger will happen under the new label Skydance, which will continue to oversee the two separate companies. However, as the mega-merger marches forward, it will be without Warner Bros.' Motion Picture Chairs Michael De Luca and Pam Abdy.
Skydance Will Have New Leaders
Paramount Motion Picture co-chairs, Josh Greenstein and Dana Goldberg, will reportedly oversee both Warner Bros. and Paramount under the new merger, with the former WB heads set to make their exit. Deadline reports the duo didn't know their fate until Oct. 1. Ellison reportedly never reached out to them.
This comes after Warner Bros.' most recent big release, Tom Cruise's panned social satire Digger, is an epic flop, expected to lose between $125 million and $160 million. What had started initially as a potential Oscar run for Cruise, it turned out to be a mission impossible, since crit Warner Bros. 7th Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film Reveals Ending Theme Song With Music Video
posted on  by Alex Mateo
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Friday that Junko Yagami is performing the ending theme song "Haruka e, Eien e" (To the Distance, To Eternity) for Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation), the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 (Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes. The company streamed a music video for the song:
Yagami previously performed an ending theme song for the 1983 Final Yamato film.
The company also unveiled a rainbow-colored visual featuring the characters:
The films' character designer Nobuteru Yūki drew the main visual (pictured right).
The film will open in theaters in Japan on October 30. The overall anime is premiering as seven films. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime under the title Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199.
The sixth film, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), opened on June 26. In the story, the Yamato passes through a space time node that brings the main characters to the year 2026 in the present-day Reiwa era in Tokyo.

Now available for pre-order and ready to rise within the next two years, the DX version of this collectible is one that fans will want to hurry and summon.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! Kodansha USA Publishing started releasing Matsu's manga adaptation in English digitally in 2024. Kodansha USA describes the story:
Ever since she was a child, Eliane has been the saint and protector of the Kingdom of Belkheim, warding off monsters and ensuring bountiful harvests with her prayers. But when a pretender saint beguiles the foolish prince—to whom she is engaged—into believing she is nothing but a fraud, he calls off the marriage and banishes her from the kingdom. Homeless and penniless but free to chart her own course for the first time in her life, Eliane decides to make for the neighboring kingdom, where she hopes to blend in as a commoner and lead a quiet life…but a chance encounter on the road will totally upend her modest plans.
Utsuzawa launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2020. Kodansha began publishing the light novels with illustrations by Pukyunosuke in January 2021. The seventh volume shipped in Japan in December 2024.
Mokuba Matsu's manga adaptation debuted April 2021 in Kodansha's Palcy app. Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on July 30. K MANGA is also publishing the manga in English.

This Is the End Stagnation Committee Light Novels Have Anime in the Works
posted on 2026-10-03 11:11 EDT by Egan Loo
Kien Aien's story of youths taking on the coming apocalypse
The "Dengeki Bunko Fall Festival Online 2026" announced on Saturday that Kien Aien's Kochira, Shūmatsu Teitai Iinkai. (This Is the End Stagnation Committee.) light novel series has an anime in the works.
The story imagines if our world is actually in the middle of an apocalypse, unbeknownst to most people. Weird creatures beneath Tokyo's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail perched on the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord who looks like a beautiful girl …. Yet, in the underbelly of society, there are boys and girls who fight the coming apocalypse while giving it the middle finger. They can't cancel the apocalypse, and they can only delay it. Still, they take their arms into battle. Why? To them, this is just day-to-day life, a ritual festival every day for the young.

The Batman – Part II Following multiple days, production on The Batman Part II is finally underway. While it won't be hitting the big screen until 2028, images taken from the set have revealed the first look at Robert Pattinson's return as Bruce Wayne.
The photos, which have been spreading on social media, appear to be from a scene where Pattinson's Bruce Wayne faces a crowd of angry protesters in Gotham. They seem to be no fans of Bruce after the events of The Batman, with people holding signs with messages like, "Death to billionaires." Members of the press are also taking photos of the secret vigilante as he is escorted through the crowd by security. Along with revealing a look at Pattinson back as Bruce, the images also hint at the unrest in the city when The Batman Part II picks up.
Robert Pattinson Will Be Joined by Other Familiar Faces
Pattinson is one of several stars of the first movie confirmed to return for The Batman Part II. He'll be joined by Jeffrey Wright as James Gordon, Andy Serkis as Alfred Pennyworth, and Colin Farrell as The Penguin. It is rumored that Barry Keoghan will also return as the Joker, but that hasn't been confirmed. Take Charge of My Heart The web novel-based live-action Korean seriesTake Charge of My Heart released its main trailer on September 28, ahead of its October 9 premiere.
Based on the web novel of the same name, Take Charge of My Heart is a romantic comedy about Ho-rang Baek (Young-kwang Kim), a third-generation chaebol executive whose artificial heart battery is running out; and Bo-bae Na (Su-bin Chae), a drama writer who gained the ability to generate electricity after being struck by lightning as a child.
Bo-bae discovers that her electric ability has no effect on Ho-rang, while Ho-rang discovers that staying near her can recharge his artificial heart battery. The two eventually enter into a three-month contract involving physical contact so that Bo-bae can help keep Ho-rang's battery charged before his next surgery.
The newly released trailer follows Bo-bae as she meets Ho-rang, the only person immune to her electrical powers. After discovering that his battery recharges around her, Ho-rang proposes a three-month contract to stay together, saying he needs her help to survive.

posted on 2026-10-04 21:37 EDT by Ken Iikura-Gross
Just in time for the new anime's premiere
Epic Games announced on Saturday that the Black Clover anime is appearing in its Fortnite Battle Royale video game for the annual Fortnitemares event. The announcement featured Black Clover characters Asta, Yuno, and Noelle as player cosmetic skins with the caption, “Don't lose hope in the nightmare.”
Asta, Yuno, and Noelle are now in the Fortnite Shop, which tells fans, “Take on the Island's curses with the help and magic of your friends!”
Epic Games teased the Black Clover collaboration in the Fortnitemares trailer on September 29. The trailer briefly shows the Asta player cosmetic in Asta's Devil Form.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Civil War II #3 – The Death of the Hulk (June 2016) In every Look Back, we examine a comic book issue from 10/25/50 years ago (plus a wild card every month with a fifth week in it). This time around, I'm a bit late as I look at July 2016's shocking death of the Hulk during the Civil War II crossover event.
In the last decade or so, comic book fans have grown accustomed to the corporate synchronicity between the world of comic books and the world of comic book FILMS, where comic book companies figure that it makes sense to tie the events of the comic books to the events of the very popular movies based on their characters. There tends not to be as much of an overlap as you would think, but it is totally reasonable for the companies to still want to try it (after all, there was a HUGE boom in Batman comic book sales when the Batman movie came out, so why NOT chase that hope?).
Therefore, when Captain America: Civil War came out, loosely adapting the hit Marvel crossover event, it made sense to do a sequel to that event, and while Civil War II definitely didn't hit the same way as the original event, it still ended up having a major impact on the Marvel Universe, especially with the death of the Hulk in June 2016's Civil War II #3 by B In July 2016, Civil War II #3 depicted the controversial death of Bruce Banner, sparking major debate in the Marvel Universe. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Zoids: Chaotic Century manga to conclude with new chapters in 2027 Zoids: Chaotic Century is officially set to continue with brand-new chapters after more than two decades.
Per Inside Games, manga artist Michiro Ueyama has announced that he will be producing the final chapter of the Zoids: Chaotic Century manga series next year. The original Zoids: Chaotic Century manga ran from 1999 to 2001 in the pages of Monthy CoroCoro Comic, while Ueyama produced his own fan manga, Zoids EX: Chaotic Century, around the same time via his personal website.
Zoids: Chaotic Century's Original Manga Artist Confirms Return of the Story in 2027
Zoids EX: Chaotic Century was discontinued shortly after it began, and was an unofficially produced title, yet it will serve as the basis for the Zoids: Chaotic Century finale after Ueyama received the official blessing of Takara Tomy, which owns the rights to the Zoids franchise. While details regarding the plot of the upcoming finale remain under wraps, those familiar with Ueyama's work will likely have a good idea of what to expect from the series when it returns in 2027.

Fire Force Season 3 – Cour 2 Trailer Released Fallout star Kyle MacLachlan has shared fresh updates on how far the production has progressed on Season 3, along with a potential release window. The Emmy-nominated actor is known for playing Hank MacLean in the Prime Video series.
In a video shared by CrazyGirlVids on X, MacLachlan shared the filming update while speaking with a fan at a signing for his new memoir. The actor said that the third season is nearing its final stretch, with about a month left to shoot. “We’re still shooting away. We’ve got about a month or so to go,” the 67-year-old said.
He later added, “(and then) probably come out maybe May or June. Fingers crossed that it’s soon.” While the actor did not give a specific year, his comments suggest that filming could wrap around November 2026. That said, it is very likely for the show to premiere in May/June 2027.
Prime Video has yet to announce a release date for the show. Hence, his May or June estimate is not an official timeline from the streamer.
What else do we know about Fallout Season 3 so far?
While official plot details remain under wraps, the upcoming season will continue the story after the events of Season 2. The Moon on a Rainy Night News
The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime's 1st Video Reveals Cast, More Staff
posted on  by Rafael Antonio Pineda
The official website for the television anime of Kuzushiro's The Moon on a Rainy Night (Amayo no Tsuki) manga began streaming the anime's first full promotional video on Wednesday. The video announces the anime's main cast members, as well as more staff members.
The cast members include:
Iori Saeki as Saki Kindaichi
Sora Amamiya as Kanon Oikawa
The newly announced staff members include Seung Deok Kim and Tsutomu Tomoyuki as assistant directors, Haruko Nobori as the color key artist, Mai Ichioka as the art director, Atsushi Satō as the compositing director of photography, Masahiro Gotō as the editor, Nobuyuki Abe as the sound director, and jizue as the musical composer. CompTown president Masao Yamamura is also credited as animation producer.
Tomoe Makino (Aharen-san wa Hakarenai, A Tale of the Secret Saint, Woodpecker Detective's Office) is directing the anime at CompTown. Shōgo Yasukawa (Food Wars!
